_help: The hero alone to start. Secondary characters (3 to 7 more, each { name, role, lock: one sentence of 20 to 300 characters starting with the first name, never_changes, sheet: null, views: [] }) are added later by the agent character_keeper (write_cast_file) or during the first run if the owner already has a cast in mind. The hero's pose sheets go in cast/<hero id>/ (closeup-front.png, waist-front.png, full-front.png at least), made with concept/make-cast.mjs.
